text: Helps trace how a repository fits together and suggests where to start making changes

text: Supports Plan Mode to scope and manage larger changes before implementation
quote: Scope changes, use Plan Mode, and ship bigger work with confidence

text: Can reproduce issues, isolate root causes, and verify fixes
quote: Reproduce issues, narrow the root cause, and verify the fix

text: Inspects diffs and runs checks to catch problems before merging code
quote: Inspect diffs, run checks, and catch problems before you merge

text: Lets you add plugins, skills, MCP servers, and rules from a single management surface
quote: Add plugins, skills, MCPs, and rules from one place

text: Integrates with GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, JetBrains, Slack, Linear and more
quote: Work with GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket, JetBrains, Slack, Linear, and more

text: Lets you choose between multiple frontier AI models from different providers
quote: Choose between every cutting-edge model from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, SpaceXAI, and Cursor.

text: Can launch fleets of agents working in parallel on tasks for hours or days
quote: Launch fleets of agents that work in parallel on ambitious tasks for hours or days.

text: Supports always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to build, maintain, and fix software
quote: Set up always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers to build, maintain, and fix your software.

text: Runs as a terminal agent, and can also collaborate via Slack and review PRs on GitHub

text: Lets you hand off development tasks to the agent so you can focus on decisions

text: Agents use their own compute to build, test, and demo features end-to-end for review

text: Provides an official CLI installable via a single curl command
quote: curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash

text: Supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect the agent to external tools and data sources

text: Lets users install MCP servers from a marketplace and authenticate via OAuth
quote: Click "Add to Cursor" on a marketplace entry to install it and authenticate with OAuth.

text: Allows configuring custom MCP servers via a JSON configuration file
quote: Configure custom MCP servers with a JSON file

text: Enterprise admins can restrict which MCP servers users are allowed to run

text: MCP servers can return rich media like images, screenshots, and diagrams to the agent

text: Users can toggle individual MCP servers on or off without removing their configuration

text: Requires user approval by default before an MCP tool can be used
